name: A record of who did what
summary: An append-only log of every meaningful action, so you can answer 'who changed this?' months later.

provenance.source: SimpleHire — its admin audit log, including the decision to write the actor, the entity and the change as separate columns rather than a message string
provenance.changes: Added redaction of the recorded values and made the table append-only in the application layer, because an audit log that can be edited is not evidence of anything.

extensionPoints.description: Name your own auditable actions here.

postInstall: Call audit() from anything that changes data someone might later ask about.
limitations: Append-only is enforced by this component, not by the database. Someone with direct database access can still delete rows.
It records what your code tells it. An action that never calls audit() leaves no trace.
